Package com.hiface.sdk.access

Class HiFaceAccessInfo

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.access.HiFaceAccessInfo
public final class HiFaceAccessInfo extends java.lang.Object
SDK status snapshot for display and diagnostics. It does not replace the validation performed by each SDK operation.

    • getFeatureMask

      public long getFeatureMask()
      Six capability bits, from low to high: detect, capture, feature, liveness.rgb, liveness.ir, search. Search includes searching and adding or updating face-library entries. RGB passive and action liveness share liveness.rgb. Snapshots are for display; the SDK validates actual operations.
